recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned male portrait featuring a three-quarter view, anchored by a prominent white diagonal banner at the bottom containing bold, sans-serif display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a dark, textured background
Diagonal white banner cutting across the lower third
Extreme wide tracking in the top header text
Strong key light creating deep shadows on one side of the face
coreInvariants: Thin white border framing the entire composition
Diagonal text orientation for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait centered horizontally, slightly cropped at the top of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white diagonal banner at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes of the subject, moves down to the bold diagonal title, then up to the wide-tracked header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, moody space surrounding the head, particularly on the left side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep amber and warm browns in the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the diagonal banner and thin outer border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow highlights on the clothing and in the header text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep blacks and bright highlights; saturated warm tones.

composition.overlap: Placed inside a white diagonal bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, tilted display type and light, widely-spaced metadata type.

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the main title
Extreme tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and modern feel of the display text.
Good for the top metadata text when tracked out widely.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic close-up portrait of a young man with styled hair, looking off-camera. Use warm, dramatic lighting (Chiaroscuro) with amber and gold tones. The background should be dark and textured. Add a thin white frame around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick white diagonal banner across the bottom third. Inside the banner, place bold uppercase sans-serif text in a dark gradient. At the very top, add a single line of uppercase sans-serif text in gold with extreme letter spacing spanning the full width.

verificationChecks: Is the top text extremely tracked out?
Is there a thin white border around the edge?
Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color grade
Thickness of the outer white border
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the banner
Check that the diagonal banner does not obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the thin white border is consistent on all four sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Portrait + Diagonal Banner Overlay + Wide-Tracked Header + Warm Color Grade
